column3: vt. 簸, 扬(谷), 吹掉, 把挑出来, 精选;vi. 扬谷, 分出好坏, 飞翔
column5: Recruiters winnow hundreds of applications down to a shortlist within a week.
column6: 招聘人员在一周内从数百份申请中筛选出入围名单。

column3: a. 似黄铜的, 厚脸皮的;n. 铜头高尔夫球棍
column5: The brassy trumpet cut through the murmur of the crowded market.
column6: 嘹亮刺耳的小号声穿透了拥挤市场的嗡嗡人声。

column3: a. 恢复健康的, 恢复期的, 渐愈的, 康复的;n. 恢复中的病人, 康复的人
column5: The convalescent soldiers wrote letters home from the seaside hospital.
column6: 康复期的士兵们从海滨医院给家里写信。

column3: a. 草本的, 叶状的, 绿色的;草的
column5: Herbaceous borders line the greenhouse, blooming from early spring to October.
column6: 温室旁的草本花境从早春一直开到十月。

column3: vt. 擦掉, 删掉, 除去
column5: The court ordered the state to expunge the wrongful conviction from all records.
column6: 法院责令州政府从所有档案中删除这起误判记录。

column3: n. 划破, 割破, 裂伤撕碎;撕裂, 裂伤
column5: The emergency room cleaned the laceration and gave the cyclist a tetanus shot.
column6: 急诊室清理了裂伤，并给骑行者打了破伤风针。

column3: a. 期待着的, 先行的, 提早发生的;先行
column5: An anticipatory hush fell over the auditorium before the results were read.
column6: 宣读结果前，礼堂里先是一片屏息期待的安静。

column3: vt. 支付, 支出;支付或准备支付
column5: The scholarship fund will defray travel costs for students presenting at the conference.
column6: 奖学金将为学生赴会演讲的差旅费买单。

column3: a. 不能复归的, 不能削减的, 不可约的;不能复位的, 不能还原的
column5: The essay argues that curiosity is the irreducible core of scientific progress.
column6: 文章认为好奇心是科学进步不可化约的核心。

column3: n. 寡头政治, 寡头政治的政府;寡头政治, 寡头政治集团, 少数人垄断的组织
column5: Historians described the regime as an oligarchy of shipping families.
column6: 历史学家称该政权是航运家族的寡头统治。

column3: a. 踏上高跷的, 虚饰的, 夸大的, 夸张的, 呆板的, 不自然的, 做作的
column5: Their stilted conversation at dinner revealed how far the old friends had drifted.
column6: 晚餐上生硬客套的交谈显出老友间已渐行渐远。

column3: a. 反对偶象崇拜的, 打破旧习的
column5: The gallery's iconoclastic curator hung the portraits upside down on purpose.
column6: 画廊离经叛道的策展人故意把肖像倒挂。

column3: n. 擦除, 抹掉;擦掉
column5: The film explores the gradual erasure of regional dialects from broadcasting.
column6: 影片探讨了地方方言在广播电视中逐渐消失的过程。

column3: a. 宫殿似的, 宏伟的, 堂皇的, 庄严的
column5: The shipping family's palatial mansion now houses the city museum.
column6: 航运家族的宫殿式豪宅如今成了市博物馆。

column3: vt. 贬低, 降低
column5: Counterfeiting schemes debase the currency and erode public trust in banks.
column6: 假币犯罪使货币贬值，并侵蚀公众对银行的信任。

column3: v. (使)结合, (使)连结, (使)联合
column5: The two expressways conjoin at a massive interchange south of the airport.
column6: 两条高速公路在机场以南的巨型立交处交汇。

column3: a. 新鲜的, 凉爽的, 爽快的, 振奋精神的;n. 联条, 支撑物, 支柱, 背带
column5: The team set out under a bracing wind that cleared the morning fog.
column6: 团队在驱散晨雾的凛冽寒风中出发。

column3: n. 遁辞, 借口, 托辞;遁词, 托词, 藉口
column5: Using a fake accent as subterfuge, the reporter slipped into the shareholders' meeting.
column6: 记者借假口音作幌子混入了股东大会。

column3: n. 祖传的财物, 继承物;世袭财产, 遗产
column5: The lawsuit argued that the collected artifacts belonged to the nation's cultural patrimony.
column6: 诉讼主张这些文物收藏属于国家的文化遗产。

column3: n. 树木园, 植物园
column5: Couples stroll through the arboretum every Sunday to see the rare maples.
column6: 每逢周日，情侣们漫步植物园观赏稀有枫树。

column3: n. 刺, 刺痛, 柳条篮子;v. 刺, 扎, 戳, 引起刺痛, 使感到刺痛
column5: The wool scarf caused a slight prickle against her neck all afternoon.
column6: 整个下午，羊毛围巾让她的脖子微微发刺。

column3: n. 勒杀, 绞死, 压缩;绞窄; 勒颈, 勒颈窒息
column5: The coroner ruled out strangulation and classified the case as accidental asphyxiation.
column6: 法医排除了勒杀，将该案定性为意外窒息。

column3: n. 地沟, 冲沟
column5: Flash floods turned the dry gulch into a roaring brown torrent.
column6: 山洪暴发把干涸的冲沟变成咆哮的褐色激流。

column3: n. 遵奉习俗, 遵纪守法者, 遵奉国教会惯例者
column5: In that conservative office, the conformist instinct discouraged anyone from questioning procedure.
column6: 在那间保守的办公室，从众心理让人不敢质疑流程。

column3: n. 愉快, 温和, 和蔼
column5: The chair's easy bonhomie put nervous first-time presenters quickly at ease.
column6: 主任随和亲切的态度让初次报告的人很快放松。

column3: a. 淀粉的, 浆糊的, 浆糊状的, 古板的
column5: The chef boils the starchy potatoes until they fall apart into puree.
column6: 厨师把富含淀粉的土豆煮到软烂成泥。

column3: n. 假装, 做作, 矫情;矫饰, 矫情
column5: His British accent seemed an affectation learned from late-night television dramas.
column6: 他的英国口音像是看深夜英剧学来的做作腔调。

column3: v. (使)冻结, (使)凝结
column5: The candle wax will congeal into odd shapes if you pour it cold.
column6: 蜡液冷倒会凝结成奇怪的形状。

column3: n. 同人, 圈内人, 小集团
column5: The author's loyal coterie of readers awaited each monthly newsletter.
column6: 作家忠实的小圈子读者每月都盼着她的通讯。

column3: n. 赝品, 假珠宝;a. 伪造的, 不诚实的, 卑鄙的, 险恶的
column5: He made yet another snide remark about his colleague's cheap laptop.
column6: 他又对同事的廉价笔记本电脑冷嘲热讽。
